|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 5 February 2003). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Imperial Domination (V) (Virtual Set 4)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown). Full text: “Deploy on table. If you have any non-Imperial characters (or starships) on table, place in Lost Pile. Neither player may draw more than two battle destiny in a battle. Whenever you initiate (or win) a battle, you may retrieve any one Imperial, and once per turn, whenever you draw an Imperial for destiny, you may take that card into hand to cause a redraw. Suspended while opponent occupies more locations than you do. [Immune to Alter]”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Deploy on table. If your non-Imperial character or [Independent] starship on table, this Effect lost. Unless you occupy fewer locations than opponent: if you initiate or win a battle, retrieve an Imperial; during battle, may take an Imperial just drawn for destiny into hand to redraw. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' “you have any” → “your”; “characters (or starships)” → “character or [Independent] starship”; “place in Lost Pile. Neither player may draw more” → “this Effect lost. Unless you occupy fewer locations”; “two battle destiny in a battle. Whenever” → “opponent: if”; “(or win)” → “or win”; “you” → “retrieve an Imperial; during battle,”; “retrieve any one Imperial, and once per turn, whenever you draw” → “take”; added “just drawn”; “destiny, you may take that card” → “destiny”; removed “cause a”; “Suspended while opponent occupies more locations than you do. [Immune” → “(Immune”; “Alter]” → “Alter.)”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153629/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards4.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards4.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 4, slip 39. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Imperial Domination]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth#Cards|Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
